Clashes erupt at anti-migrant march in Portsmouth

Anti-migrant demonstrators and counter-protesters clashed during a march in Portsmouth. Police are searching for six men in connection with the disorder that occurred during the event. The specific details of the clashes and the number of individuals involved in the disorder were not further elaborated in the coverage.
